labels.shortDescription: Refusal: a Find query document cannot be read.
labels.value: This query could not be read. Open it again from Find, or build it again.

labels.shortDescription: Refusal: a Find query has no columns or more than 20.
Refusal: rows to show is out of range.
labels.value: Rows to show must be a whole number from 1 to 2000.

labels.shortDescription: Refusal: a field cannot be sorted on. {0}: the field.
labels.value: This field cannot be used to sort: {0}. Choose another.

labels.shortDescription: Refusal when the user lacks the Find and Export Records permission.
labels.value: Find needs the Find and Export Records permission. Ask your administrator to assign you the BarnCRM Find and Export permission set.

labels.shortDescription: Refusal when someone changes a saved query they do not own.
labels.value: Only the person who saved this query can change, share or delete it. Use Save as to keep your own copy.

labels.shortDescription: Refusal when a saved query is gone or no longer shared.
labels.value: This saved query no longer exists, or is no longer shared with you.

labels.shortDescription: Refusal when a saved query has no name or a name over 80 characters.
labels.value: Give the query a name of up to 80 characters.

labels.shortDescription: Shown when Find fails for a reason it cannot explain.
labels.value: Something went wrong in Find. It has been recorded in the Error Log. Try again, and tell your administrator if it happens again.
